chatgptPrompt: Create a Shorts cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Subject: a dried drop of coffee seen from above on cream paper, a dark ring at the edge and a pale middle, with faint curved flow streaks running outward. Composition: the drop centred, filling the middle of a vertical frame. Lighting and treatment: soft daylight, visible paper grain; a daylight lab or an everyday room, clean and exact, cream background #E9E3D3, ink #1B1E24, one blue #2F5BFF accent, soft strobe-ghost stamps, premium editorial science documentary look, clearly a code-rendered illustration rather than a photograph. Mood: curiosity. Text: No text. Scientific accuracy: a drying drop whose edge is pinned to the surface is replenished by an outward flow that carries the specks to the edge, making a ring; oval specks can spread out instead. Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real photograph or a news image. Style: distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art. Keep the focal point and any text inside the centre safe area, clear of the bottom 25% and the right-hand buttons.
